system.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls use your Melee Proficiency, and every Talent here counts toward your Melee rank. Every talent here requires this. You gain the Clinch action.
Clinch ❶ Stance While you are in this stance, a bare hand counts as a rigid implement: you may Parry, Bind, and Gain Control with it, and a creature whose weapon or limb you Control with a bare hand is also Grabbed. At Master rank, a creature you have Grabbed cannot Recenter.
